title: Succeeding sin he multiplied his guilt and his punishment
html_source: The priests were scaring Stephen by telling him of the eternal suffering he will suffer if he gets into hell; however, Stephen feels pleasure from for example, masturbation or having sex with a prostitute, so this makes him feel guilty for feeling the pleasure in committing a sin.
